note_matnota: The house was abandoned for a long time, how could someone live in such precarious conditions, unless life is the last thing of value here.
note_matnotab: DollMaker usually checks his watch 4 times while torturing his victims, a man obsessed with time never lives in peace.
note_matnotac: You could try entering the numbers in ascending order.
note_matnotad: Time is a silent killer, maybe this time it will help you catch one.
note_matnotae: I woke up early today, had breakfast very calmly knowing that I gave all of them the eternity and beauty of a doll.
note_matnotaf: At first they are usually noisy, but once they realize I did them a favor they stop complaining. I guess it's part of them sharing their happiness with me.
note_matnota2: How I love them, I have them all with me, I don't need anything else. I don't care if the world ends tomorrow, as long as I have them, I'll be fine.
tut_1: Your sister Katherine was murdered by the infamous serial killer 'DollMaker'.
tut_2: He specializes in hunting women, abusing them, and then dismembering them.
tut_3: The police have chased him for years, but he always slips away.
tut_4: If the police cannot find the culprit, you will. You have spent years studying this case.
tut_5: Freddy is out shopping and will return in 15 minutes. He is about to move away.
tut_6: Your mission: Collect enough evidence to prove Freddy IS the DollMaker.
tut_7: CONTROLS: [WASD] Move, [MOUSE] Look, [SPACE] Jump, [SHIFT] Crouch, [E] Interact, [Q] Portfolio, [ESC] Pause.
tut_8: You have 15 minutes. Be careful. If time runs out, you will lose your only chance to catch him.

menu_go_story_1: The serial killer returned home and found you inside.
menu_go_story_2: He entered, massacred you, and tore you to pieces.
menu_go_story_3: You became just another one of his victims,
menu_go_story_4: and nobody ever heard from you again.
menu_go_story_6: For Freddy, you were his favorite toy because you dared
menu_go_story_7: to take the risk of entering his house to investigate him.
